Class and contract
Cleanroom class
ISO 3, 4, 5, 6 & 7 (Class 1, 10, 100, 1K, 10K)

In Semiconductor: ISO 14644-1 grades a cleanroom by how many airborne particles a cubic metre of its air may hold. Each step down the scale is a tenfold reduction, and the Class numbers in brackets are the older US equivalents. Wafer and backend processes sit at the tight end because the features being printed are measured in nanometres.
